title: Mimas prop
description: One non-unit body a map hex can carry (props/*.json): a pillar, a wall. A prop with stats.hp is destructible and is a legal target; without, it is a permanent wall that cannot be hit.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the id.

bodyHeight.description: Height in units above the tile top: what this prop blocks sight and trajectories with.

aimHeight.description: Where attacks land on it, in units above the tile top. 1..bodyHeight, required even for a wall so a client can place a marker.

stats.description: Omit for an indestructible wall. hp makes the prop a legal target; defences are per lane, as in rules.baseStats. No ap, no power.
